criteria.requirement: Add frontmatter.parsing ParseResult/ParseError/parse_result(text, encoding="utf-8", handler=None, defaults=None, strict=False). Results expose status (absent/present/malformed/non_mapping), independent metadata, stripped content, actual handler and error. Explicitly distinguish malformed/split failure and non-mapping roots from absent metadata; empty/null YAML is a valid empty mapping. Strict mode raises ParseError carrying the same result for malformed/non_mapping only. Preserve legacy parse/loads behavior and custom-handler authority. Compact/nested JSON introduced by the earlier delivery must work through the new result API. Decode errors remain real decode errors, never absent status.

Investigate the real source, explain the call path and clarify the business requirements before obtaining plan approval and implementing. Deliver real engineering changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. Repair independently reported failures; questions, answers and documentation do not count as separate completed objectives.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual business behavior and the frozen scope; do not grade by matching the reference patch text.
